newsitem.title: USA: Mecklermedia says quarterly oper losses possible.
newsitem.headline: Mecklermedia says quarterly oper losses possible.

text.p: Mecklermedia Corp said Friday that it may face operating losses in quarters when it does not have significant trade shows.

Mecklermedia said some of its operations are cyclical in nature. The number and size of trade shows and magazine promotions in a particular quarter "have and will continue to significantly impact the company's quarterly results," the company said.
Meckelermedia said its second quarter earnings of $0.40 a share, compared to a loss of $0.21 a share last year, are not necessarily indicative of annual results or trends.
The company did not provide specific earnings forecasts.

During the second quarter, Mecklermedia continued its trade show growth and investment in publishing operations. The company increased the frequency of Web Week from biweekly to weekly and launched the Internet Shopper magazine.
Continued investment in the publishing operations will result in operating losses in the near term in quarters where there are not significant trade shows, the company said.
Mecklermedia, however, said it believes its publishing investment will enable it to continue its growth and to maintain a "dominant force in the Internet media business."
